Extensions.File:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue' $log = 'C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\MergedSpecialize.log' Start-Transcript -Path $log -Append try { # Remove preinstalled inbox apps selected by file 1. & 'C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\RemovePackages.ps1' & 'C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\RemoveCapabilities.ps1' & 'C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\RemoveFeatures.ps1'
# Prevent consumer-feature and cloud-optimized content suggestions. $cloud = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent' New-Item -Path $cloud -Force | Out-Null New-ItemProperty -Path $cloud -Name 'DisableCloudOptimizedContent' -PropertyType DWord -Value 1 -Force | Out-Null New-ItemProperty -Path $cloud -Name 'DisableWindowsConsumerFeatures' -PropertyType DWord -Value 1 -Force | Out-Null
# Remove OneDrive setup launchers/shortcuts and suppress automatic Chat install. Remove-Item -LiteralPath @( 'C:\Users\Default\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\OneDrive.lnk', 'C:\Windows\System32\OneDriveSetup.exe', 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\OneDriveSetup.exe' ) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue reg.exe add 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Communications' /v ConfigureChatAutoInstall /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f | Out-Null
# Suppress Edge's first-run page and background startup features. $edge = 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Edge' New-Item -Path $edge -Force | Out-Null New-ItemProperty -Path $edge -Name HideFirstRunExperience -PropertyType DWord -Value 1 -Force | Out-Null $recommended = Join-Path $edge 'Recommended' New-Item -Path $recommended -Force | Out-Null New-ItemProperty -Path $recommended -Name BackgroundModeEnabled -PropertyType DWord -Value 0 -Force | Out-Null New-ItemProperty -Path $recommended -Name StartupBoostEnabled -PropertyType DWord -Value 0 -Force | Out-Null } finally { Stop-Transcript }
